items.title: Kalshi sues Louisiana to block enforcement of state gambling laws, iGaming Times reports
items.content_text: - **Kalshi sues Louisiana to block enforcement of state gambling laws, iGaming Times reports** — KalshiEX LLC sued Louisiana Attorney General Liz Murrill, Governor Jeff Landry and the Louisiana Gaming Control Board in federal court on October 23, arguing the Commodity Exchange Act preempts state gambling laws for its sports contracts. The suit targets enforcement powers under Act 182 that took effect August 1, including fines up to 100,000 dollars, and opens the prediction market fight in the Fifth Circuit. items.content_text: - **Brennan Center study finds prediction market odds sway voters by 10 to 20 points, Brennan Center reports** — A Brennan Center study of 1,994 registered voters conducted September 21 found voters were 10 to 20 percentage points more likely to pick a candidate favored by prediction markets, regardless of polls.
